summary: Fresh direct sources verify Ridgewood's controlling investment and Mike Hart's significant retention by March 9, 2026. They do not establish the complete cutoff-current registered direct owner set, fund/vehicle, stakes/votes, legacy seller and rollover dispositions, certified conversion continuity or exact passenger/Mendocino carve-out. Keep the existing Sierra platform unchanged and preserve a precise fresh exception.
resolvedFormerBlockers: Ridgewood's current March 9 release directly confirms acquired control, Hart's significant retained investment, Sierra Northern and Railpower subsidiaries, CVAT add-on and Brookfield debt. It supplies no exact legal holder, fund, vehicle, stake, votes or complete retained/seller set.

Northborne's current March 11 adviser release confirms a completed sale with undisclosed financial terms and unnamed passenger operations and mainline rights. It does not resolve the Mendocino/Skunk operating perimeter.
